intro: Every bloon type and property: how tough it is, what it shrugs off, when it first shows up and which towers handle it. Health is hits to pop one layer; RBE (red bloon equivalent) is the total pops inside. Speed is compared with a Red Bloon.

bloons.name: Red Bloon
bloons.summary: The weakest bloon: one hit pops it and it leaves nothing behind.

picks.note: Cheap hero that pops early rounds alone.

bloons.name: Blue Bloon
bloons.summary: A little faster than Red; pops into one Red.

picks.note: Its boomerang hits a whole line of them.

bloons.name: Green Bloon
bloons.summary: Faster again; CHIMPS starts with them on round 6.

picks.note: Three Dart Monkeys (one on Strong) are the classic CHIMPS start.
On Strong it chips Greens anywhere on the map.

bloons.name: Yellow Bloon
bloons.summary: Much faster: slow projectiles miss it, so pick accurate or instant attacks.

picks.note: On a corner its tacks cover every direction.

bloons.name: Pink Bloon
bloons.summary: The fastest regular bloon (3.5× Red). Often comes out of Blacks, Whites and Purples.

picks.note: Fast, seeking shurikens; sees Camo too.

bloons.name: Black Bloon
bloons.summary: Small and immune to explosions, so early Bomb Shooters and Mortars let it through.

picks.note: Shurikens pop it and see Camo.
Lets your explosive towers pop Black (and Zebra).

avoid: Bomb Shooter and Mortar before Heavy Shells (x-3-x) or Striker Jones.

bloons.name: White Bloon
bloons.summary: Small and immune to freezing, so it walks through Ice Monkeys.
avoid: Ice Monkey freezes and Mermonkey freezing waves.

bloons.name: Purple Bloon
bloons.summary: Fast and immune to energy, plasma and fire: magic bolts, lasers and fire skip it.

picks.note: MIB lets towers in range pop Purple.

tips: Wizards, Super Monkey lasers, Dartling lasers and fire attacks need help here.

bloons.name: Lead Bloon
bloons.summary: Slow but shrugs off sharp, cold and energy attacks. Fortified Leads take 4 hits.

picks.note: Explosions pop Lead from the start.
Acid pops Lead; Acidic Mixture Dip shares it.
MIB lets towers in range pop Lead.

bloons.name: Zebra Bloon
bloons.summary: Immune to both explosions and freezing, like Black and White together.

picks.note: Lets explosions pop Black and Zebra.

bloons.name: Rainbow Bloon
bloons.summary: No immunities, but 47 bloons inside: it tests pierce.

picks.note: Ring of Fire on a corner.

bloons.name: Ceramic Bloon
bloons.summary: The first bloon with real health (10, 20 if Fortified). From round 81 they become Super Ceramics with far more health.

picks.note: Juggernaut deals bonus damage to Ceramics.
The Bloon Solver beats late Ceramics.
Embrittlement adds damage to every hit.

bloons.name: MOAB
bloons.summary: The first blimp (round 40): slow but tanky. Fortified MOABs have 400 health.

picks.note: MOAB Mauler is the standard round 40 answer.
Destroyer shreds it on water maps.

bloons.name: BFB
bloons.summary: Very slow and very tanky (700 health); attacks that only work up to MOABs can't touch it.

bloons.name: ZOMG
bloons.summary: A huge slow blimp (4,000 health) holding four BFBs. Many hooks and stuns can't grab it.

picks.note: Cripple MOAB stuns and weakens it.
Super Brittle makes it take more damage.

bloons.name: DDT
immune: Sharp, shatter, cold, energy and explosions
bloons.summary: Fast (faster than a Ceramic) and Black + Lead + Camo at once: most towers can't see or hurt it.

picks.note: Bloon Sabotage slows DDTs on the whole map.
Archmage excels on DDT rounds (needs camo support).
Glue Strike lets lead-blocked towers hurt them.
Icicle Impale with a camo Village can handle them alone.
White Hot Spikes pop DDTs at the exit.

tips: Rounds 90 and 95 are the DDT checks in CHIMPS.
Mortar Shattering Shells (with the Paint Stripper MK) removes Fortified from DDTs.

bloons.name: BAD
bloons.summary: The Big Airship of Doom (20,000 health): ignores slows and stuns and releases two ZOMGs and three DDTs.

picks.note: Spike Storm's ability handles the round 100 BAD.
First Strike can skip a damaged BAD's insides.
MOAB Hex deals percentage damage, great against BADs.
Super Brittle boosts everyone's damage on it.

tips: Save single-target burst for it and keep DDT answers ready for what comes out.

bloons.name: Camo
bloons.summary: Camo bloons can only be targeted by towers with camo detection. They appear from round 24 (round 5 in ABR); DDTs are always Camo.

picks.note: Radar Scanner gives every tower in range camo detection.
Cleansing Foam strips Camo and Regrow.

tips: Round 78 (camo Ceramics) and round 90 test camo detection on your main towers.

bloons.name: Regrow
bloons.summary: Regrow bloons grow back a layer every 3 seconds, up to what they started as. They appear from round 17 (round 3 in ABR).

picks.note: Ring of Fire pops whole groups before they regrow.

tips: Pop them in one place with lots of damage instead of chipping them along the track.

bloons.name: Fortified
bloons.summary: Lead, Ceramic and blimp bloons can be Fortified: Leads take 4 hits and Ceramics and blimps have double health. Children aren't Fortified unless they can be.

picks.note: Juggernaut deals bonus damage to Fortified bloons.
Embrittlement adds damage to every hit.
MOAB Mauler hits Fortified blimps hard.
